scope: Reviewable migration proposal; not an executable installer or automatic update.
preserve_user_text: Match only existing compatible property IDs and preview all proposed edits. Do not overwrite personalized values silently.
incompatible_changes: Arena frame changes from shape to image and needs a new native source binding.
timer_policy: Do not restore running timers, alerts, receipts or cooldown state.
update_policy: Install into a separately reviewed empty project or official transaction after capacity validation; no automatic in-place replay.
